name: noodleplanner
description: Front-end tooling for NoodlePlanner. The app has no bundler: mppwriter and exceljs are vendored into static/vendor/ by `npm run vendor:mppwriter` and `npm run vendor:exceljs`.

scripts.test:js: node --test tests/test_mpp_browser_export.mjs tests/test_markdown_roundtrip.mjs && for f in tests/test_*.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
